// ------------------------------------------------------------
// New MEC groups:
// - InterpGroup_30 copies Mec1 (original InterpGroup_7)
// - InterpGroup_31 copies Mec2 (original InterpGroup_8)
// - SeqVar_Object_76/77 expose Mec6/Mec7
// - SeqVar_Named_58/59 resolve those names
//
// - Use new slot 6/7 positions and headings
// ------------------------------------------------------------
